status: post-outcome referee-led V3 module amended after a non-citable provisional contract review and frozen before authoritative Gate 2 output execution

cells.role: authenticated Gate 1 occupation-month aggregate; restricted SCC input

membership.role: fixed 468-occupation Rule-A beta membership and readable names

model_audit.role: independently upheld Gate 1 A1 numerical targets

calendar.rule: exclude the transition month from static accounting; retain the genuinely missing October 2025 as absent and never interpolate

support.occupation_count_denominator: fixed canonical 468-occupation Rule-A beta plus Webb universe

employment_share_denominators.national: sum of young plus older CPS final-weight stock over all 468 occupations and 71 preperiod months
employment_share_denominators.within_family: same preperiod stock within the row SOC2 family
employment_share_denominators.within_quintile: same preperiod stock within the column exposure quintile

support.support_graph: an undirected five-node occupational-support topology with a family-specific edge for every pair of quintiles jointly represented in that family; its incidence rank is not a regression design-matrix or finite-estimability certificate
support.direct_tail_definition: a family with at least one canonical occupation in both Q1 and Q5
support.interpretation_limit: graph connectivity plus a common coefficient restriction is not a family-weighted average of directly observed Q5-Q1 effects

accounting.period_stock_definition: arithmetic mean of monthly CPS final-weight employment stocks over observed months in the declared period
accounting.log_stock_target: D_a = log(N_a5post/N_a5pre) - log(N_a1post/N_a1pre); D_relative = D_young - D_older
accounting.symmetric_decomposition: delta R_q = sum_g mean(s_gq) delta R_gq + sum_g mean(R_gq) delta s_gq
accounting.decomposition_units: level change in the young-to-older stock ratio, never relabeled as log points
accounting.zero_denominator_rule: classify all family-quintile-period cells; structural absences are explicit, common-positive families enter ratio terms, and all young stock outside the common-positive set is retained through a boundary-mass term; no undefined ratio is assigned zero and no stock is dropped
accounting.log_decomposition: exact three-factor Shapley decomposition of log(sum_g s_g R_g + boundary) over within-family ratios, older-family weights, and boundary mass; all eight hybrid levels must be strictly positive
accounting.inference: not executed in this module; paired uncertainty remains a Gate 3 requirement

numerical_comparison.operation: report D_relative beside each certified grouped-binomial focal target and their numerical difference
numerical_comparison.interpretation_limit: an exact aggregate log-stock identity is not automatically the grouped-binomial regression coefficient

execution.input_scope: authenticated aggregate cells only; no row-level microdata

outputs.identity_rule: the execution receipt maps every non-receipt output filename to a result_id computed from this spec_id, the logical filename, and the output artifact SHA-256
